title: VIXEN configure cannot discover a generated Undertow provider
body: A fresh VIXEN configure failed because the worktree had no paired generated Undertow root; the successful documented-compatible workaround was to set UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow/.claude-worktrees/cgsuitevel before the queued configure. The VIXEN facade/build setup should resolve or provision the generated provider without manual lane selection.

title: Renderer identity test must preserve UNDERTOW_ROOT during Ninja regeneration
body: The two-configure byte-identity test configured with UNDERTOW_ROOT but its first nested build regenerated build.ninja without that process-only environment and failed in libraries/Text/CMakeLists.txt. The test now wraps nested builds with cmake -E env UNDERTOW_ROOT=...; the build/test facade should carry provider-root environment through regeneration automatically.

title: Renderer identity test must retain generated RecipeSimd prerequisites
body: The initial two-tree identity test disabled VIXEN_CODEGEN_GATE to shorten setup, but the renderer dependency closure still compiled SVO and failed for missing Recipe/generated/RecipeSimd.g.hpp. The test now leaves codegen enabled; the facade should expose the minimal generated-input contract for renderer object tests instead of requiring trial-and-error gate settings.

title: GPU witness must wait for GoogleTest discovery output
body: The first queued ctest selection immediately after the RenderGraph target link reported no tests because GoogleTest's generated test_rendergraph_criticalnodes_infra1[1]_tests.cmake was not yet present; rerunning after discovery materialized passed 140 tests. The build/test facade should make target build completion and CTest discovery atomic for GPU witnesses.
